compute_policy: Experiments are run in the container; GitHub is persistence/review/reproducibility only.
current_architecture: interface normalization -> behavioral semantic grounding -> causal source applicability -> source-specific ABI/action adapter -> common action/state-transition distribution -> sparse probability fusion -> program composition

negative_boundaries.arbitrary_whole_action_codebook_few_shot: does not generalize to unseen actions

interpretation: Shared raw token logits, tokenizers, output-head dimensions, and at least some decoding architectures are not necessary in controlled screens. Current evidence favors source-specific behavioral ABI adapters into a common action/state-transition probability space followed by sparse probability fusion.
next: Add an attention-based Transformer specialist as a held-out architecture/source absent from applicability calibration.
Jointly test opaque commands + position-free grammar normalization + unseen-source applicability + heterogeneous architectures + private output ABIs + common-action probability fusion.
Learn stage termination/segmentation instead of supplying stage boundaries externally.
Test learned latent transition representations instead of an explicit integer action vocabulary.
